notes: Entries are ordered by documented development chronology, not numeric label. Missing versions and unknown dates are not invented. Local evidence is stripped before publication. 0.79.2 and 0.79.5 are current uncommitted working-tree campaigns at this review, not new Git releases. Analyzer/MCP have independent version domains.

entries.title: Direct scale controls and clearable Band assignments.
entries.note: Bounded UI correction. Saved schema 58 and native interface 9 are unchanged; physical artist acceptance remains separate.

changes.text: Scale controls appear directly below the density curve without opening Advanced.
Band models, Points and assignment groups toggle on and off with a click, including an empty selection. Assignment edits support Undo/Redo.

entries.title: Independent Band scale curves.
entries.note: User-selected development patch label. Schema 58 requires fresh setups; prior scenes need their matching build. See local evidence for qualification limits.

changes.text: Band scale profiles: Off, Follow Density and Custom, with an independent editable size curve and preserved random Min/Max variation.
Saved scale graphs retain Band ownership through reorder, copy and reopen. Manual keeps published plants and radii until Update.

entries.title: One editing workflow. Reversible source types.
entries.note: Development source; automated checks are recorded in the implementation evidence. New installers, physical artist acceptance and publication remain pending.

changes.text: Removed the floating layer editor and Go to assigned Band navigation. Edit through the Scatter or source-container Modify panel.
Compact Pick object and Make point actions preserve source row identity, settings and Band assignments. Points use Manual radius; supported model geometry can use Auto.
Band model assignments appear below width/range and before density. Advanced Scale has adjacent Min and Max fields.

entries.title: Explicit Bands. Faithful field feedback.
entries.note: Local Max 2026/2027 development delivery with bounded validation. Heavy-scene performance, complete physical artist and renderer acceptance remain open.

changes.text: Stable Path/Band controls, Independent ranges, density curves, Rounded/Sharp corners and accepted-owner identification colors.
Selected/combined field previews, clipped boundaries and saved Auto Radius with independent XY/3D spacing metrics.
Empty Consecutive Bands reserve their intervals. Manual field feedback preserves published plants/radii and labels pending inputs.
Fresh current-schema setups only; old scene migration, placement readers and obsolete prototype paths are removed.
Models & Points hover no longer triggers a full panel layout. Layout mode switches avoid reflowing unrelated sections and rewriting unchanged controls.
Hidden Band list hosts no longer cover Clusters and Spline bands on first opening Layout.
Removed permanent help paragraphs from settings panels; controls, counts, pending states and errors remain visible. Detailed guidance remains in the website and tooltips.

entries.title: Safer recovery. Unit-aware distances.
entries.note: Source validation in Max 2026/2027; no new installer. Native Paint/Edit rescaling and physical release acceptance remain guarded or pending.

changes.text: Publication failures retain the previous complete result across native allocation and scripted installation checks.
Schema 56 stores distances in unit-aware fields and migrates the immediately preceding schema 55 while keeping multipliers dimensionless.

entries.title: More focused previews. Clearer creation.
entries.note: First panel construction and physical creation-input acceptance remain open.

changes.text: Local color edits prepare only affected layers and reuse unchanged sibling display buffers.
Failed preview staging retains the complete previous result and clears recovered sibling errors.
New controller icons appear during placement and sizing, before a plant cache exists, and return correctly after Undo.

entries.title: Keep layers and navigation in sync.
entries.note: The reported physical Live picker disappearance remains unresolved.

changes.text: Manual layer removal and display switching keep each preview attached to its published owner.
Cached viewport records and retained radius lines reduce repeated work during navigation.
Radius display toggles and their Undo/Redo preserve pending Manual placement edits.

entries.title: Points, palettes and softer boundaries.
entries.note: Cross-system-unit conversion of per-area falloff distances remains unresolved.

changes.text: Assign Point sources directly to Spline bands; replace a Point with a model while retaining its row identity.
Models & Points, Source containers and boundary density/scale controls are easier to reach.
Layer copy includes band choices and guides; area selection reflects Include, Exclude and mixed selections.
Add Point Undo restores the correct source type and identity.

entries.title: Offline team-pilot activation.
entries.note: A development team pilot, not a completed commercial licensing release.

changes.text: Owner-issued offline activation and renewal for team testing, with a 30-day license from issuance.
Expired pilot licenses lock creation/editing while existing saved scenes remain loadable and renderable.

entries.title: Safer source rectangles. Matching brush radius.

changes.text: Selecting a source rectangle no longer calls removed paint-set properties.
Enable collection switches start off, allowing rectangles to be positioned without collecting scene geometry.
The Painter cursor now matches the authored radius, including transformed receivers.
Area density and paint feedback are directly available in Painting.
Unchanged brush status skips panel layout; active Painter callbacks prepare intermediate borders without waiting for the script timer.
Final stroke completion flushes remaining border feedback while preserving Manual publication behavior.
Corrected the first status-timer callback that immediately stopped a newly started brush session.
Narrow Amount radio groups, color captions and resized editor swatches fit their native control bounds.
Matching Max 2026 and Max 2027 vector-brush packages and focused button/callback checks.

entries.title: The vector Paint Area foundation.
entries.note: New saved format: older stroke setups are rejected without conversion. The initial Start Brush failure was corrected in 0.78.1.

changes.text: Replaced saved stroke replay with receiver-bound vector regions: Paint unions coverage and Erase cuts holes.
Cached borders, inward/outward feathering and separate density and scale curves.
Oversized circular gestures clip to receiver boundaries and retain visible borders.
Cached incremental feedback and smaller gesture Undo records reduced repeated work in the former stroke brush.
This stroke-based implementation was later replaced by vector Paint Areas in 0.78.

entries.title: Independent receiver streams.
entries.note: The first rebuild changes older combined-sampler placements. Caps, count redistribution, geometry edits and shared spacing still affect output; old Edit bindings need explicit handling.

changes.text: Persistent receiver-local random sequences and plant identities preserve unchanged base candidates when surfaces are added or reordered.
Reuse prepared receiver candidates and prepare only new or changed receivers.
Bound aggregate Brush preparation and accelerate historical face-to-dab indexing.

changes.text: Each layer owns receivers; named Paint Areas target one receiver while sharing the layer models and population.
Receiver lists, resizable lists, per-object view state, labels and identification colors clarify editing.
List drag grips no longer trigger cursor-position exceptions.

Modify, linked-container editing and the optional layer editor bind the same records; compact sections reduce empty space.
Container startup and Add/Copy layer callbacks retain valid owners across panel refreshes.
Retained previews and ordered publication were exercised with real plants and stress scenes.
Integrated the selected-layer editor into native Modify while keeping the popup optional.
Warm popup topic changes bind edits to the correct layer and controller.
Local Start/Stop/Save/Status diagnostics controls without an MCP requirement.

entries.title: Real scenes and relevant Live updates.

changes.text: An editable pavilion workflow and optional floating layer editor.

A new deterministic candidate/acceptance pipeline with explicit spacing ownership, protected edits and bounded publication.

changes.text: Integrated the initial procedural Brush and native layer editor over the retained preview foundation.
Source-local mesh geometry and placement matrices use retained GPU instancing during navigation.
Completed point positions stay in graphics buffers while the camera moves.
Display-only point budgets choose the intended bounded subset instead of undershooting through integer strides.
Held mouse navigation avoids repeated layer synchronization without changing the shown population.
Prepared transformed proxy triangles and batched CPU submission reduce repeated redraw work.
Native source filtering/transforms, prepared boundary queries, bounded clustering workers and coalesced redraw requests preserve ordered output.
